title: X-Men: Inde Navarrette Shares Thoughts on MCU Rogue Casting Ahead of Reboot
content:
Inde Navarrette has shared her reaction to joining the MCU as Rogue. Marvel recently announced the Obsession star as part of the ensemble of its upcoming X-Men reboot.
